verdict.rationale: Working Copy's manual documents previewing HTML and document files. It also says the preview reloads automatically when the file or any local asset it depends on changes, restoring scroll and zoom, and that the preview can be opened from other devices via External URL. missing for 10: explicit documentation of Markdown rendering (only 'html and document files' is named), independent or hands-on corroboration of live reload.

support.subject: As a developer, I can preview Markdown, HTML, and other rendered files with live reload

citations.quote: File content is shown with syntax highlighting for sourcecode and a preview of html and document files.
The preview reloads automatically when the file or any local asset it depends on changes, restoring scroll and zoom
You can also preview from other devices or computers by enabling _External URL_.
